cases.explain: Больной is a predicate adjective/noun describing the subject я, so it is nominative.
The negated verb не даст (won't give) governs the genitive case for its object here.
The verb сказать (to tell/say to someone) takes its indirect object — the person told — in the dative case.

cases.sentence: А как-то Константин Гаврилович подстрелил ___, и вы попросили сделать из нее чучело.
cases.explain: Чайку is the direct object of the transitive verb подстрелил (shot), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Отец с ___ всюду расставили сторожей, чтобы даже близко не подпустить ее к усадьбе.
cases.explain: The preposition с (together with) governs the instrumental case.
The preposition в (in) denoting location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Отец с мачехой всюду расставили сторожей, чтобы даже близко не подпустить ее к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward/near) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Мы все стареем, так сказать, выветриваемся под воздействием ___.
cases.explain: Стихии (of the elements) is a genitive modifier of воздействием (effect/influence), expressing 'effect of X.'

reading.ru: Имею честь с прискорбием доложить, что лошади поданы.
reading.question: What announcement is made about the horses?
options: That the horses have been brought around (are ready)
That the horses have run away
That there are no horses available
reading.correct: That the horses have been brought around (are ready)
reading.explain: The line announces, 'лошади поданы' — the horses have been brought round.

reading.ru: Так вы уж, Ирина Николаевна, сделайте милость, наведите справочку, где теперь актер Суздальцев.
reading.question: What favor is Irina Nikolaevna asked to do?
options: Find out news about the actor Suzdaltsev
Write a letter to the newspaper
reading.correct: Find out news about the actor Suzdaltsev
reading.explain: She is asked to make inquiries about where the actor Suzdaltsev is now.

reading.ru: И вот, когда они в одной драме играли заговорщиков, и когда их накрывали, то надо было сказать, мы попали в западню.
reading.question: What line from an old play is being recalled here?
reading.correct: 'We have fallen into a trap'
reading.explain: The memory recalls the line from a play about conspirators: 'мы попали в западню' — we have fallen into a trap.

reading.ru: Борис Алексеевич, я решила бесповоротно, жребий брошен.
reading.question: What decision does Nina announce to Trigorin?
options: That she has decided irrevocably, the die is cast
That she is returning to her father's house
That she will never act again
reading.correct: That she has decided irrevocably, the die is cast
reading.explain: She declares, 'я решила бесповоротно, жребий брошен' — I have decided irrevocably, the die is cast.

reading.ru: Остановитесь в Славянском базаре.
reading.question: Where does Nina tell Trigorin to stay in Moscow?
reading.correct: The Slavyansky Bazaar
reading.explain: She says, 'Остановитесь в Славянском базаре' — stay at the Slavyansky Bazaar.

reading.ru: Старик каждую минуту спрашивает, где Костя, где Костя, жить без него не может.
reading.question: What does the old man (Sorin) constantly ask about?
reading.correct: Where Kostya (Konstantin) is
reading.explain: The line says the old man keeps asking every minute, 'где Костя' — where is Kostya.

reading.ru: Надо бы сказать, чтобы сломали в саду тот театр.
reading.question: What does someone suggest should be done to the old theater/stage in the garden?
reading.correct: It should be torn down
reading.explain: The line suggests, 'чтобы сломали в саду тот театр' — that they should tear down that theater in the garden.

reading.ru: Наш ребеночек, небось, голоден.
reading.question: What concern is raised about the baby?
options: That the baby is probably hungry
That the baby has a fever
reading.correct: That the baby is probably hungry
reading.explain: The line worries, 'Наш ребеночек, небось, голоден' — our baby is probably hungry.

reading.ru: Твой отец не даст мне лошади.
reading.question: What does Masha say about getting horses from her father?
options: That her father won't give her horses
That her father already gave her horses
That her father sold the horses
reading.correct: That her father won't give her horses
reading.explain: She says, 'Твой отец не даст мне лошади' — your father won't give me horses.

reading.ru: Никто не думал, не гадал, что из вас, Костя, выйдет настоящий писатель.
reading.question: What did no one expect Konstantin (Kostya) would become?
reading.correct: A real writer
reading.explain: The line says no one thought or guessed that Kostya would become a real writer.

reading.ru: Безнадежная любовь – это только в романах.
reading.question: What is said about hopeless love?
options: That it only exists in novels
That it is the strongest kind of love
reading.correct: That it only exists in novels
reading.explain: The line dismisses it: 'Безнадежная любовь – это только в романах' — hopeless love only exists in novels.

reading.ru: У меня теперь в доме шестеро, а мука семь гривен пуд.
reading.question: What complaint is made about household expenses?
options: There are six people in the house now, and flour costs seven grivnas a pood
There is no food left in the house
reading.correct: There are six people in the house now, and flour costs seven grivnas a pood
reading.explain: The complaint states there are now six people in the house, and flour costs seven grivnas per pood.

reading.ru: Когда я не принадлежал себе ни днем, ни ночью, мне удалось скопить две тысячи.
reading.question: How much did the doctor manage to save over thirty years of restless practice?
reading.correct: Two thousand
reading.explain: He says he managed to save two thousand over thirty years of restless practice.

reading.ru: Человек, который хотел.
reading.question: What is the working title of the story idea Sorin wants to give Kostya?
reading.correct: 'The Man Who Wanted'
reading.explain: Sorin says the story should be called 'Человек, который хотел' — The Man Who Wanted.

reading.ru: Вы 25 лет прослужили по судебному ведомству только и всего.
reading.question: How many years did Sorin serve in the judicial department, according to this line?
reading.correct: 25 years
reading.explain: The line states, 'Вы 25 лет прослужили по судебному ведомству только и всего.'

reading.ru: Она ушла из дома и сошлась с Тригориным.
reading.question: What happened between Nina and Trigorin, according to Dorn's account?
options: She left home and took up with Trigorin
reading.correct: She left home and took up with Trigorin
reading.explain: Dorn says, 'Она ушла из дома и сошлась с Тригориным' — she left home and took up with Trigorin.

reading.ru: Ребенок умер.
reading.question: What happened to Nina and Trigorin's child?
reading.correct: The child died
reading.explain: The line states simply, 'Ребенок умер' — the child died.

reading.ru: Подписывалась чайкой.
reading.question: What did Nina sign her letters with?
reading.correct: 'The Seagull'
reading.explain: The text says she signed herself 'чайкой' — as 'the Seagull.'

reading.ru: Отец с мачехой всюду расставили сторожей, чтобы даже близко не подпустить ее к усадьбе.
reading.question: What did Nina's father and stepmother do to keep her away?
options: Posted guards everywhere to keep her from the estate
Sent her money to stay away
Wrote her letters begging her to return
reading.correct: Posted guards everywhere to keep her from the estate
reading.explain: The text says her father and stepmother posted watchmen everywhere so she couldn't even get near the estate.

reading.ru: Действительный статский советник Сорин.
reading.question: What title is given to Sorin in this passage?
reading.correct: Active State Councillor
reading.explain: The text names him, 'Действительный статский советник Сорин.'

reading.ru: Ирина Николаевна говорила мне, что вы уже забыли старое и перестали гневаться.
reading.question: What did Irina Nikolaevna tell Trigorin about Konstantin's mood?
options: That Konstantin had forgotten the past and stopped being angry
That Konstantin still refuses to speak to him
That Konstantin has left for good
reading.correct: That Konstantin had forgotten the past and stopped being angry
reading.explain: The line says Irina Nikolaevna told him Konstantin had already forgotten the old grudge and stopped being angry.

reading.ru: И никто не знает вашей настоящей фамилии.
reading.question: What does the public not know about Trigorin, according to this line?
options: No one knows his real surname
No one knows where he lives
No one knows what he writes about
reading.correct: No one knows his real surname
reading.explain: The line says nobody knows his real surname, since he publishes under a pseudonym.

reading.ru: В него еще играла наша покойная мать, когда мы были детьми.
reading.question: Who used to play the old lotto game when the children were young?
reading.correct: Their late mother
reading.explain: The line recalls, 'В него еще играла наша покойная мать, когда мы были детьми' — our late mother used to play it when we were children.

reading.ru: Если бы я жил в такой усадьбе, у озера, то разве я стал бы писать?
reading.question: What does the doctor imagine he would do if he lived at such a lakeside estate?
options: He would not become a writer, and would just fish instead
He would become a fisherman for a living
reading.correct: He would not become a writer, and would just fish instead
reading.explain: He wonders if he lived at such an estate by the lake, would he even become a writer, and imagines he'd just fish instead.

reading.ru: А как-то Константин Гаврилович подстрелил чайку, и вы попросили сделать из нее чучело.
reading.question: What had Konstantin once done with a seagull, as recalled here?
options: He shot one and had it stuffed
He painted a picture of it
He wrote a song about it
reading.correct: He shot one and had it stuffed
reading.explain: The line recalls, 'Константин Гаврилович подстрелил чайку, и вы попросили сделать из нее чучело' — Konstantin shot a seagull and you asked to have it stuffed.
